subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the 14 official GitHub Action upgrades, including actions that receive repository secrets and write-capable tokens, be approved as one grouped dependency update after rebase and green checks?
rationale: The patch is mechanically correct, but accepting new third-party executable code at secret-bearing workflow boundaries requires explicit repository-owner trust judgment.

options.title: Approve grouped update after gates
options.body: Keep the grouped PR, verify the official release SHAs, rebase it, and merge after all affected checks complete.

options.title: Split privileged action upgrades
options.body: Separate Codex, app-token, Docker publishing, and security-upload actions from lower-risk setup and labeling updates for independent review.

options.title: Pause this update cycle
options.body: Leave the existing pins in place and close or defer the group if maintainers cannot review the privileged upstream changes now.

recommendation.title: Approve grouped update after gates
recommendation.body: Keep the grouped PR, verify the official release SHAs, rebase it, and merge after all affected checks complete.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository history shows the broadest ownership of GitHub Actions modernization and the affected docs, CI, and Docker workflows.
